text.tspan: EC2 purchasing options (think of a hotel)
pay per second (Linux/Windows, after the 1st minute),
per hour for others · no commitment · highest cost
book a room long in advance
up to ~72% off · fixed instance type, region, tenancy, OS
All/Partial/No upfront · Regional or Zonal scope
Convertible RI: change type, ~66% off · resell on RI Marketplace
up to ~72% off · commit to $/hour of usage
EC2 Instance SP: locked to family + region, flexible size/OS/tenancy
usage above the commitment = On-Demand price
up to ~90% off · AWS can take it back with a
2-minute warning when your max price < spot price
a physical server just for you; you see sockets/cores
hardware not shared with other AWS accounts;
may share with your own instances; no control of placement
book a room, pay even if
reserve capacity in one AZ for any duration
NO discount by itself (combine with RI/SP) · billed running or not
short events that MUST get capacity
